P15.3: the infrastructure map + network explorer — honest-rendering rules and the static-PMTiles serving contract

The two §39.3/§39.4 public surfaces on P15.1's epistemic visual language and
zero-JS/a11y baseline. Honest-rendering rules are pure, tested logic
(web/src/lib/map.ts, network.ts): the coverage↔point single bound control
(SIG-UI-017), low-coverage≠low-density desaturation (SIG-UI-018), national-zoom
binning + per-tier point honesty (SIG-UI-019/GEO-011), no-coordinate jurisdiction
indicators with a conservation law (SIG-UI-020), ego-default sharing/network
(SIG-UI-021/022), the structurally-required inline ER-quality disclosure on every
centrality statistic (SIG-UI-023/IDENT-030), the three unmerged §12.2 access edge
types (SIG-UI-024), and access-path closure with per-hop evidence + speculative
label beyond the hop threshold (SIG-UI-025/RECON-050), mirroring
inference.access_paths.

The static-PMTiles serving contract (SIG-UI-038, SIG-GEO-012/013) lands as a
served, tested artifact at /map/style.json — a MapLibre GL style over self-hosted
PMTiles v3 with OSM attribution and no third-party tile CDN — without bundling the
maplibre-gl runtime, a recorded deviation from ADR-018 that keeps the ADR-049
zero-JS invariant and the Lighthouse budgets green. The shipped /map/ and /network/
pages stay zero-JS with the tabular/list equivalent as the source of truth.

ADR-051 records the design + deviation; traceability and the risk register carry
the P15.3 rows. Additive: the P15.1 reference surfaces and fixtures are untouched.
